column1: # realized_options fixture data — MATLAB reference for parity testing
# Source: realized/realized_options.m — Default options factory for realized volatility estimators
#             exact string matching for string values
# The function returns a struct of default option values for the specified realized
# volatility estimator.  Only fields relevant to the selected estimator are included.
# All values below are deterministic defaults — no RNG state involved.
#   'preaveraging'         — Pre-averaged realized variance and related estimators
#   2. multivariate_kernel:  realized_options('multivariate kernel') — same defaults as kernel
#   3. optimal_sampling:     realized_options('optimal sampling')  — overrides noise params
#   4. twoscale:             realized_options('twoscale')          — same overrides as optimal_sampling
#   5. multiscale:           realized_options('multiscale')        — same overrides as optimal_sampling
